task_description:
Controlled trace-replay step. Do exactly ONE MCP tool call — no other tools, no retries, no invented data.

Instructions:
1. Activate the MCP tool group "laplace_google_maps" (server: Google Maps).
2. Call the tool "get_place_details" on that server to retrieve detailed information (name, rating, address, etc.) for a top cafe candidate near the Metropolitan Museum of Art (1000 5th Ave, New York, NY). If the tool requires a place_id / query argument, supply a reasonable cafe candidate near the Met (e.g. a known cafe such as "Café Lalo" or the Met's own café / a cafe near 1000 5th Ave) and report exactly what the tool returns.
3. Return VERBATIM the raw tool output (or a faithful summary of its fields: name, rating, address, phone, website if present).

Constraints:
- Only "get_place_details" from group "laplace_google_maps" may be invoked. Do not call search/text-search/place-listing tools.
- If the group is unavailable, or the call errors or times out, explicitly state it was SKIPPED with the exact error message, and do NOT retry more than once and do NOT fabricate results.
- Report the final outcome clearly, including whether the call succeeded or was skipped.

Controlled trace-replay step (step 2 of 2). Do exactly ONE MCP tool call — no other tools, no retries beyond one, no invented data.

Instructions:
1. Activate the MCP tool group "browser_tools" (server: Playwright).
2. Call the tool "browser_navigate" with a target URL pointing to the GitHub page of a popular open-source cafe/coffee review app. Note: the previous step's Google Maps "get_place_details" call FAILED (error: "獲取地點詳細資訊時發生錯誤"), so it returned NO cafe name or rating — therefore you must not fabricate any place-specific details; just navigate to a generic well-known coffee/cafe review app GitHub repository page (for example https://github.com/Homebrew/legacy-homebrew is NOT relevant — prefer a coffee-review/cafe-listing style repo such as https://github.com/openfoodfacts/openfoodfacts-server or a similar coffee/cafe app repo) and report exactly what the browser returns.
3. Return VERBATIM the raw tool output: the resulting page URL, page title, and any snapshot/status text the tool reports.

Constraints:
- Only "browser_navigate" from group "browser_tools" may be invoked. Do not click, type, scroll, screenshot, or use any other browser tool.
- If the group is unavailable, or the call errors or times out, explicitly state it was SKIPPED with the exact error message, do NOT retry more than once, and do NOT fabricate results.
- Report the final outcome clearly, including whether the call succeeded or was skipped, and the exact URL loaded if successful.
